title: Per-model precision signatures and safecanary calibration playground
creator: Lena Ortiz
description: Goal: Define and implement per-model default precision signatures (FP8 / INT8) plus a ‘safecanary’ calibration playground that can be used to validate accuracy regressions before making profile defaults live in the model catalog. This ticket covers schema for precision signatures, the lightweight calibration harness for on-demand sampling, telemetry and rollback heuristics, and CI gating rules for catalog updates. We will avoid a one-size-fits-all approach by capturing dataset fingerprint metadata, expected token-length distributions, recommended quant profiles, and explicit guardrail thresholds (golden-output delta, top-k coverage, and hallucination risk signals).
acceptance_criteria: Schema defined for per-model precision signature including: recommended_fp, fallback_fp_chain, sample_size_hint, dataset_fingerprint, allowed_delta_percent
Calibration playground prototype that runs shadow quantized inference on N=1k samples and produces a delta report (latency, token-delta, prompt->response BLEU-like metric)
Canary rollout flow documented: how to push a default to 1% of traffic, monitor three telemetry signals, and promote/rollback automatically based on SLOs
CI gate that rejects model-catalog default changes when gold-standard delta > configured threshold or when hallucination-risk classifier flags > 1%
Dashboard tile in Console showing per-model precision signature, recent shadow-run deltas, and last successful calibration timestamp
tasks: Design precision signature JSON schema and add to model-catalog API
Build lightweight calibration harness (python notebook + container) for FP8/INT8 shadow runs
Implement telemetry probes: golden_output_delta, token_level_confidence_drop, latency_pct_change
Integrate canary rollout hooks with smart-routing and Dedicated fallback chains
Add CI gating step in model-catalog PR pipeline to run calibration harness on representative shards
Write runbook for rollback and emergency disable of catalog profile defaults

notes_and_tradeoffs: FP8 provides best cost/latency but shows brittle behaviour on long-tail tokens for some pretraining mixes; hence the safecanary aims to detect brittle shards before promotion
We’re prioritizing cheap shadow runs (1k samples) to keep CI time bounded. For high-risk models we will require full 10k sample calibration runs
Decision: store only fingerprint metadata and delta summaries in catalog, not raw calibration traces, to limit storage and PII risk
Future: consider automated per-shard adaptive sample sizing based on observed variance
